document.title: PER-3/PJ/2026: Tata cara penyampaian, penerimaan, dan pengolahan SPT

delta.note: PER-3/PJ/2026 governs the procedures for submitting, receiving, and processing tax returns (SPT): deadlines, extensions, submission channels, completeness checks, recording, and exemptions from filing. These are purely administrative and reporting rules. The document does not change any value, rate, threshold, table, rounding, deduction, PTKP, or calculation step for PPh 21 withholding on permanent employees. References to PPh 21 concern only filing extensions and the treatment of overpayments in individual annual returns, which is administrative.
